ruleDefinitions.name: PUA - Mouse Lock Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: In Kaspersky's 2020 Incident Response Analyst Report they listed legitimate tool "Mouse Lock" as being used for both credential access and collection in security incidents.

sequences.query: (process_product = RGX(".*Mouse\\ Lock.*") OR process_company = RGX(".*Misc314.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Mouse\\ Lock\\_.*"))
